protocol.name: fern_wm_v1

description.summary: the compositor core and the window manager

protocol.description:
A private protocol between fern-comp (the core: screen, input, client protocols, rendering, animation) and fern-wm (the window manager: all policy). Only the window manager process the core started can bind it. The prose specification is docs/protocols/wm.md.
Windows and outputs are named by integer ids the core assigns; an id is never reused while the core runs. Requests take effect at commit, all at once. Coordinates are logical pixels in the global space.

interface.name: fern_wm_v1

description.summary: the window manager's view of the desktop

interface.description: Bound once by the window manager. On bind the core describes every output and window it has, including what a previous window manager process saved (restore, restore_wm), then sends done.

event.name: work_area

description.summary: the part of an output windows should use

event.description: The output minus what the shell keeps for itself (the menu bar, a dock that does not hide): where zoomed and tiled windows go and new windows are placed. Sent after `output`, and again when it changes.

event.name: window_size

description.summary: the client committed content of this size

event.description: The first one means the window is mapped (has drawn something).

event.name: window_decoration

description.summary: who draws the window's titlebar

event.description: Sent before the first window_size, and again if it changes. With server-side decoration a titlebar of titlebar_height sits above the content once the window manager asks for it (decoration request); with client-side decoration the client draws its own and the frame is the content.

event.name: restore

description.summary: after a window manager restart: where a window is

event.description: Sent after the window event, during the burst that ends with done.

event.name: window_icon

description.summary: where a dock shows the window

event.description: Global logical pixels, from foreign-toplevel set_rectangle; 0x0 when no dock shows it. Minimize animates towards it. Also sent before restore after a restart.

event.name: pointer_button

description.summary: a button went down or up

event.description: Always sent for presses on the desktop, on decorations, and on any window whose content the client does not get (pointer grabbed by the window manager); for content clicks the client gets it too.

request.name: grab_keyboard

description.summary: key events go to the window manager, not clients

request.description: Taking the keyboard, the window manager first gets a key event with keysym 0: its modifiers are the ones held at that moment (so the app switcher knows whether Super is still down).

request.name: overlay_clear

description.summary: start a new overlay

request.description: The overlay is replaced at commit by what follows; it is drawn above all windows again until overlay_beneath says otherwise.

request.name: overlay_beneath

description.summary: draw the overlay just below a window

request.description: Draws the overlay just below window id instead of above everything (the tiling preview goes under the window being dragged). 0: above all windows. Reset by overlay_clear.
